# Cycle19: an explicit elliptic-height acquisition certificate

The strongest completed result is a conditional mathematical construction and
independently replayed exact certificate supplying numerical constants for
the release's single-fold Diophantine construction. It closes a concrete
acquisition gap in the printed proof. It does not certify the entire
single-fold conjecture resolution, its Lean dependency closure, or an exported
literal polynomial. Historical novelty and any comparative speed advantage
remain UNKNOWN.

Worker: logic_gate14, root-verified GPT-6.1 Sol/max. Date: 7 October 2026.
No nested workers, commits, publications, author contacts or paid services.
Only this worker's cycle19 directories were written. No release scripts,
Lake configuration, project builds or dependency patches were executed.

## Selection and actual source reading

Assigned families 240–245 were read breadth-first through the pinned overview,
contents and complete Lean scope documents. The exact per-family dispositions
are in `FAMILY_ASSESSMENT.json`. The release is pinned to
`adc7f1241b42e322a6451854ab7e4b4c146bf78a`, whose Git timestamp is
6 October 2026 21:58:50 UTC according to the independent helper's Git-object
audit. Date or proof scope is never inferred solely from a catalogue title.

Family 242, OpenAI's *Single-fold Diophantine representations*, printed
24 September 2026, was selected and read in full: all 27 PDF pages, including
the rank descent, complete witness ledger and references. Its full main and
elliptic TeX modules were also read. Seven implementation Lean modules, the
challenge stub and its config were read in full, with other acquired files recorded at
their narrower actual read depths. The decisive PDF is frozen with SHA256
`0fa6bf81ce22ef3a220e0d05ef9dde5cd3af01fb2eb2c493b43dbcd5d79077f5`.

Family 245 was the initial second selection. Only PDF pages 1–4 and its scope
document were read; the remaining 68 pages were deferred behind the substantive
242 construction. Its system-wide weak-normalization premise must not become
an individual-term termination criterion. Other families remain author claims
at overview/scope-document reading depth; no proof of them is adopted here.

The older primary comparator Poonen 2002 was read in full, all ten pages.
